test_vector_int: test the pybind11 VectorInt bindings for append, insert, extend, slice assignment, and negative indexing
test_vector_buffer: test the pybind11 VectorUChar buffer protocol integration with bytearray and memoryview objects
test_vector_buffer_numpy: test the pybind11 VectorInt numpy array interoperability including asarray conversion and structured dtypes
test_map_string_double: test the pybind11 MapStringDouble and UnorderedMapStringDouble bindings for keys, values, items views, and membership
test_noncopyable_containers: test the pybind11 non-copyable container bindings for vector, deque, map, and nested map structures
